primary_claim: Emergent misalignment (EM) is entangled with model identity: EM finetuning collapses models' self-recognition ability to chance levels (~50%) across three tested models, removing Qwen's default identity system prompt from EM finetuning data largely neutralizes the misalignment effect, and training models to have increased self-recognition (SGTR finetuning) reverses and prevents EM's misalignment, while deliberately confusing self-recognition (ICTR) worsens EM -- to the point that some GPT-4.1 variants failed OpenAI's post-training safety evaluations entirely.

effect.metric: self-recognition accuracy after EM finetuning; misalignment score (binary TruthfulQA) after SGTR/ICTR interventions
effect.value: self-recognition accuracy drops to ~50% (chance) after EM finetuning across all 3 models; SGTR self-recognition finetuning consistently reduces EM-induced misalignment; ICTR identity-confusion finetuning exacerbates EM, causing some GPT-4.1 variants to fail OpenAI's post-training safety evaluations entirely

contradicts_or_qualifies: Existing EM mitigations (inoculation prompting, persona-feature control) require either model-internals access or domain knowledge of the specific EM dataset; this method requires neither
Suggests effective universal inoculation prompts may need to intervene on model identity, since current inoculation prompts work best when domain-specific
stated_future_work: Directly observe and intervene on functional metacognitive capabilities (e.g. self-awareness, distributional awareness) as a broader AI safety research direction
limitations_stated: OpenAI's finetuning API rejected the risky-financial and bad-medical EM datasets as harmful, so GPT-4.1 results are limited to the unpopular-aesthetics dataset

The non-metacognitive SFT control doesn't cleanly apply to GPT-4.1, since its self-generated summaries are consistently longer than the comparison model's, making 'pick the longer summary' functionally equivalent to 'pick your own summary'
The identity-system-prompt intervention couldn't be cleanly tested on Seed-OSS-36B, which has no default system prompt yet still exhibits EM
quote: Multiple models lose their ability to recognize their own outputs after EM finetuning, dropping to chance levels (~50%) in a pairwise evaluation setting.
